title: Aegeus Technologies IPO Details
intro:
Aegeus Technologies IPO is a book build issue of ₹23.71 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.23 crore shares of ₹23.71 crore.

Aegeus Technologies IPO opens for subscription on Aug 4, 2026 and closes on Aug 6, 2026. The allotment for the Aegeus Technologies IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 7, 2026. Aegeus Technologies IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 11, 2026.

Aegeus Technologies IPO is set issue price band at ₹100 to ₹105 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,52,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,78,000.

Turnaround Corporate Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Skyline Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Prabhat Financial Services Ltd.

Refer to Aegeus Technologies IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2017, Aegeus Technologies Ltd. is engaged in the business of designing and developing robotic and intelligent automation solutions. The company offers services such as software development, system integration, data management, automation solutions, and customized technology support tailored to client-specific operational and business requirements.

Aegeus Technologies emphasizes quality delivery, secure systems, and continuous innovation, enabling clients to improve productivity, optimize processes, and achieve sustainable growth through reliable technology solutions.
As on June 30, 2026, the company had total of 55 employees on payroll basis and 33 employees on contratual basis.

Incorporated in 2017, Aegeus Technologies Ltd. is engaged in the business of designing and developing robotic and intelligent automation solutions. The company offers services such as software development, system integration, data management, automation solutions, and customized technology support tailored to client-specific operational and business requirements. Aegeus Technologies emphasizes quality delivery, secure systems, and continuous innovation, enabling clients to improve productivity, optimize processes, and achieve sustainable growth through reliable technology solutions. Services: Complete Solar O&M: End-to-end operations and maintenance, including preventive and corrective maintenance, performance monitoring, and plant reporting. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC): Preventive maintenance, spare parts support, and technical assistance to ensure optimal robotic performance. Module Cleaning as a Service (MCaaS): Pay-per-use robotic solar panel cleaning service with no upfront capital investment for customers. Regional Service Network: Service hubs in Bangalore and Badi Sid (Rajasthan) with diagnostic facilities, trained engineers, and spare inventories. Spoke Warehouses: Warehouses in Hubli, Rewa, Bellary, and Surat for quick spare availability and faster service response. Field Service Support: On-site teams providing installation support, preventive and corrective maintenance, performance checks, training, and robot servicing. As on June 30, 2026, the company had total of 55 employees on payroll basis and 33 employees on contratual basis. Products Portfolio: Unicorn Smart: A fully autonomous, water-free solar panel cleaning robot for large-scale utility solar plants. Unicorn R2R: A semi-autonomous solar panel cleaning robot designed for large and mid-scale solar installations. Shreem: An intelligent, water-free robotic cleaning solution for rooftop solar installations. faqs.question: How to apply in Aegeus Technologies IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Aegeus Technologies IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Aegeus Technologies IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Aegeus Technologies IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Aegeus Technologies IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Aegeus Technologies IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
